# Solid reactivity diagnostics

Read and follow the version-matched repair guide at
`../../../node_modules/solid-js/skills/reactivity-diagnostics/SKILL.md`.

Do not guess from older Solid behavior or suppress diagnostics. Apply the
prescribed repair for the reported code, then run the narrowest check that
reproduces the diagnostic.
